dedupe_keys.name: high temporal resolution microclimate and photovoltaic power dataset for sustainable rooftop design in subtropical humid city

description: High temporal-resolution microclimate and photovoltaic power dataset for sustainable rooftop design in subtropical humid city is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ip Cheng et al. This paper presents a high resolution microclimate monitoring dataset designed to explore rooftop microclimate responses to different rooftop configurations within a subtropical humid campus setting. The dataset comprises measurements from seven rooftops representing five roofing types: bare roof, bare roof with HVAC units, green roof, PV roof, and PV integrated green roof (PVIGR). Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
